slices.S0: All 21 implementation tickets are merged. Dev delivery is verified by successful pipeline executions, including release `7c97ec40-371c-4387-8c26-817c75450d4c` (data, migration, app, web, frontend sync and smoke). The owner deferred production deployment to M3; production execution, the recorded/manual failure-injection demo and SNS email receipt are not claimed by this update.
slices.S1: The accepted plan contains 20 tickets. ADR-0008–0011 are owner-approved; the identity schema, restricted database role, claims adapter and paired /me contracts are released. The invitation trigger is deployed with its live alias READY at provisioned concurrency 1/1 and a verified synthetic uninvited denial. Cognito remains disabled. Google scopes and External/Testing audience are verified. Pool activation, actual Google federation, measured cold/warm p99, actor authorization, seeding and the frontend sign-in flow remain outstanding.

S0-20.notes: Playwright smoke and header scan are merged and pass in the dev pipeline.

S1-01.notes: Cognito pool, Google IdP, clients and typed configuration are merged and synth-tested. The dev secret, matching Google client ID and saved redirect URI were verified. Read-only review verified the three basic identity scopes and External/Testing audience. Auth is disabled and no pool is deployed; activation and live federation verification remain.

S1-02.notes: Owner accepted ADR-0008–0011 on 2026-10-11; decisions are merged in all three repositories. Live binding and latency proof are separate S1-18 acceptance work.

S1-03.notes: Backend and infra are merged and released in dev execution 7c97ec40-371c-4387-8c26-817c75450d4c. The arm64 live alias is READY with reserved concurrency 1 and provisioned concurrency 1/1. A synthetic uninvited Google event returned SIGN_UP_NOT_ALLOWED; the decision log had only safe fields and no email. Policy and PostgreSQL tests pass. The single 66 ms sample is not p99 proof; actual federated acceptance and measured cold/warm p99 remain. The pipeline build-list bootstrap issue was repaired before release. Two provisioned cold initialization samples were 2805.16 and 3057.93 ms; these small samples do not establish p99.

S1-04.notes: Identity migration and sqlc lookups are merged and applied on dev; PostgreSQL lifecycle, uniqueness and idempotency tests pass.

S1-05.notes: The /me contract and shared auth Problem responses are merged and released with frontend S1-19. The real /me endpoint remains S1-08.

S1-15.notes: Trusted authorizer claims are carried through the Lambda adapter and released to dev. Protected-route integration remains S1-06/S1-14.

S1-17.notes: presignup_ro bootstrap and exact SELECT grants on users/invitations are merged and deployed. Negative privilege tests cover writes and unrelated future tables; the deployed trigger uses its scoped IAM connection.

S1-19.notes: Frontend /me spec, generated types and test handler are merged and released with backend S1-05. The API drift gate and frontend tests pass; real endpoint/auth UI work remains S1-08/S1-10.

S1-09.notes: Started as the prerequisite for S1-01/S1-03 activation and admission acceptance. The backend seed service and paired infra dev step are prepared and locally tested: operator-only requests, production guards, transaction rollback, idempotency and safe logs. The owner selected the first dev admin. Auth remains disabled. Release build-discovery before backend seed, then infra; live seed rerun and admission verification remain pending.
